newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Bakrie Indonesia BV launches US$125 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Bakrie Indonesia BV launches US$125 mln FRN.

text.p: An arrangers group has formed for Bakrie Indonesia BV's US$125 million guaranteed floating rate notes due 2001 and the issue was officially launched on Monday, arranger and bookrunner Sumitomo Finance (Asia) said.
The guarantor of the issue, Bakrie Investindo, owns part of Indonesian listed company Bakrie and Brothers.
